hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '/(hooks|store|lib)/[^/]+\.tsx?$' || exit 0; BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE" | sed 's/\.[^.]*$//'); TEST=$(find __tests__ -name "${BASENAME}.test.*" 2>/dev/null | head -1); REL=$(echo "$FILE" | grep -oE '(hooks|store|lib)/.+'); if [ -z "$TEST" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"no-test: %s -> /sync-test %s"}' "$REL" "$REL"; else TEST_REL=$(echo "$TEST" | sed 's|.*/frontend/||'); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"[test-sync] %s modified. Check %s for needed updates. Run /sync-test %s if logic changed."}}' "$REL" "$TEST_REL" "$REL"; fi
